ConnectionStrings._comment: Placeholder only. Use the Session pooler string from Supabase (Settings > Database > Connection pooling) - the direct db.<ref>.supabase.co host is IPv6-only and unreachable from most networks. Set the real value via `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection" "..."` locally, or an env var (ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection) in hosting. See CLAUDE.md.

Jwt._comment: Placeholder only. Set the real signing key via `dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "..."` locally, or an env var (Jwt__Key) in hosting. See CLAUDE.md.

GoogleAuth._comment: OAuth client IDs are not secret (unlike client secrets), so the real values can live here. Create a Web OAuth client in Google Cloud Console and pass its ID as serverClientId/idToken audience from the Flutter app - Android/iOS client IDs alone are not valid ID token audiences for this flow. See CLAUDE.md.
